articles.title: Minten Scores Twice in Bruins’ 6-3 Win Over Sharks
Practice Report: Sturm, Lindholm Talk Early Defensive Production
In the System: Zellers Named NCHC Forward of the Week

away.summary: The Bruins are coming off a 6-3 win over the Sharks, with Charlie McAvoy returning from a six-game suspension and making an immediate impact. Fraser Minten continues to produce offensively, leading the team with four goals. The Bruins' defense has been active, scoring five times in the first seven games, and they aim to continue their three-game goal streak from the blueline in Friday's matchup against the Ducks.

home.summary: No specific information about the Anaheim Ducks' lineup, injuries, or goalie situation is provided in the articles. The focus is on the Bruins' practice in Anaheim and Hampus Lindholm's connection to the Ducks, where he was drafted and spent the first nine years of his career.
